name: Santhosh
headline: AI agents. Security systems. Useful tools.
bio: I build agentic AI systems, data-protection workflows, and the tools that connect them. My work spans Python backends, TypeScript interfaces, retrieval pipelines, and browser automation.

projects.label: Guard + govern
projects.title: Certificate management and crypto agility
projects.summary: Bringing certificate management, cryptographic assessment, and AI-assisted operations into one platform, with a Python API and a React interface.

projects.label: Reason + act
projects.title: Agents for security and data protection
projects.summary: LLM-guided browser exploration, retrieval-backed security assistants, and role-aware data protection workflows. I work on the path from finding evidence to taking a useful next step.

projects.label: Connect + create
projects.title: MCP tools with tangible outputs
projects.summary: Tools that turn an agent's work into Word reports and Excel workbooks, with file delivery through cloud storage. Small interfaces that make automation useful beyond the chat window.

notes: Exploring memory and knowledge sharing across agent crews.
Building retrieval pipelines for regulatory framework evidence.
Experimenting with LLM guardrails for sensitive input and prompt injection.
